parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.
> If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the **NodeId** parameter.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time, and the interval between the start time and the end time cannot exceed one day. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC).

parameters.name: LogicalOperator
parameters.description: The logical operator for keyword-based searches. Default value: and.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the mongos or shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

> This parameter is valid only when the **DBInstanceId** parameter is set to instance ID of a sharded cluster instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **30** to **100**.

parameters.name: QueryKeywords
parameters.description: The query keywords. Separate multiple keywords with spaces. A maximum of 10 keywords can be specified.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The role of the node in the instance. Valid values:
- **primary**: primary node.
- **secondary**: secondary node.
- **search**: search node.

> If the **NodeId** parameter is set to the ID of a mongos node, the value of this parameter can only be **primary**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC).
